title: 第17章 施针第18章 炼丹
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
秦伏天斜眼看着跪在地上的段公愚。
段公愚不由得身躯一颤，一股寒意从脊背处升起，直冲脑门。
就好像自己在这个年轻人的眼里，一切都被看透。
“这……”
段公愚心神发颤，若不是此刻秦伏天就站在他面前，看的清清楚楚这是一个十几岁的少年，他甚至会以为，这是一个活了千年万年的老妖怪。
秦伏天嘴角含着冷笑，他何尝看不出这段公愚心中所想。
这老匹夫表面上恭恭敬敬，但如果自己无法帮到他，必然转眼就会翻脸无情。
就和秦天雄这些秦家之人一样。
秦伏天前世身为神帝，这些简单的道理怎会不懂？
只是他前世身为神帝太久，身边之人对他的尽是阿谀和恭敬，即便有很多道理他懂，但自己已经有太久没有亲身体会。
所以面对秦家之人的所作所为，依旧感到寒心和世态炎凉。
“起来吧！”秦伏天淡淡看着段公愚，接着道：“你这有银针吗？”
“银针？”段公愚一愣，但接着连忙点头，“有的，有的！”
段公愚令人取来银针。
“秦公子，你这是打算施针吗？”
段公愚心中依旧有些怀疑。
秦伏天冷笑看了段公愚一眼：“怎么？莫非你以为，施针真是寻常药师的手段？”
在段公愚看来，寻常药师给凡人治病，便是采以施针之法，刺激穴位，舒筋活络，排毒卸秽，但对于武者来说，极少有施针这种凡俗手段。
而下一刻，秦伏天已是直接出手。
一根银针，直接刺向段公愚的胸口，落在膻中穴。

段公愚顿时瞳孔一缩，眼中流露出惊喜和骇然！
就在秦伏天这一针落下的同时，他感觉到一股极为清亮的感觉透心而入。
就好似让他这些天来紧绷的身心在这一瞬间都得到了放松！
而接着，秦伏天又是一针，刺入段公愚头顶的百会穴……
接着，第三针落在脊椎上端大椎穴。
第四针落在脊椎中间的中枢穴。
第五针落在脊椎末端的长强穴。
第六针和第七针，落在双耳两侧的太阳穴……
而此时的段公愚，心里的疑虑在这一刻已是完全烟消云散。
秦伏天施针的整个过程如行云流水，每一个动作都是说不出的飘逸和洒脱……
就好像秦伏天并不是在给人施针救治，而是在……是在练剑！
对，就像是在施展一门超凡的剑术！
每一个动作，看似飘逸，但实则融合了极为精妙的剑法在其中。
而且，段公愚能够明显的感觉到，在每一根落下的银针之上，都保留着灵力在其上。
对，就像是每一根银针都是一个容器，其中存放着一股灵力，而这些灵力，正不断的缓慢的从银针之上流出，而后注入到那七个穴位之中。
content_en:
Qin Futian squinted at Duan Gongyu who was kneeling on the ground.
Duan Gongyu couldn't help but tremble, and a chill rose from his back and went straight to his forehead.
It was as if everything was seen through in the eyes of this young man.
"This..."
Duan Gongyu was trembling. If Qin Futian hadn't stood in front of him at this moment and could clearly see that this was a teenage boy, he would have even thought that this was an old monster that had lived for thousands of years.
Qin Futian had a sneer on his lips. How could he not understand what this young man was thinking.
This old man appears to be respectful on the surface, but if he can't help him, he will definitely become ruthless in the blink of an eye.
Just like Qin Tianxiong and other members of the Qin family.
Qin Futian was the God Emperor in his previous life, how could he not understand these simple principles?
It's just that he was the God Emperor for too long in his previous life, and the people around him were all flattering and respectful to him. Even though he understood many truths, he hadn't experienced it personally for a long time.
Therefore, facing the actions of the Qin family, I still feel cold and cold.
"Get up!" Qin Futian looked at Duan Gongyu calmly, and then said: "Do you have a silver needle?"
"Silver needles?" Duan Gongyu was stunned, but then nodded quickly, "Yes, yes!"
Duan Gongyu asked someone to get the silver needle.
"Master Qin, are you planning to perform acupuncture?"
Duan Gongyu still had some doubts in his heart.
Qin Futian sneered and glanced at Duan Gongyu: "What? Do you think that acupuncture is just an ordinary pharmacist's method?"
In Duan Gongyu's opinion, ordinary pharmacists use acupuncture to stimulate acupuncture points, relax muscles and collaterals, and detoxify and remove impurities. However, for warriors, there are very few mundane methods such as acupuncture.
The next moment, Qin Futian took action directly.
A silver needle pierced Duan Gongyu's chest directly and landed on the Tanzhong point.
Duan Gongyu's pupils suddenly shrank, with surprise and shock in his eyes!
At the same time that Qin Futian's needle fell, he felt an extremely clear feeling penetrate into his heart.
It was as if his tense body and mind these days were relaxed at this moment!
Then, Qin Futian inserted another needle into the Baihui point on Duan Gongyu's head...
Then, the third needle is placed on the Dazhui point at the upper end of the spine.
The fourth needle is placed at the central point in the middle of the spine.
The fifth needle is placed at the Changqiang point at the end of the spine.
The sixth and seventh needles are placed on the temples on both sides of the ears...
At this moment, Duan Gongyu's doubts in his heart were completely dispelled.
The whole process of Qin Futian's acupuncture was like flowing clouds and flowing water, and every movement was indescribably elegant and free...
It's as if Qin Futian is not giving people acupuncture treatment, but... practicing swordsmanship!
Yes, it's like performing an extraordinary swordsmanship!
Every movement seems elegant, but in fact it incorporates extremely delicate swordsmanship.
Moreover, Duan Gongyu could clearly feel that every falling silver needle retained spiritual power.
Yes, it's like every silver needle is a container, which stores a spiritual power, and this spiritual power is slowly flowing out from the silver needle and then injected into the seven acupuncture points.
